findings.title: dirty.couch.vibes
findings.snippet:
If you’re planning on visiting Scottsdale, you HAVE to stay at this 📍 The Scott Resort & Spa (formerly FireSky Resort). The Scott in Scottsdale is so iconic, with the most beautiful interiors and decor alongside a gorgeous Cuban style bar and restaurant.
The average price for this hotel is about $150 to $300, depending on the time of year and room type!
We stayed here for 3 nights and it was the perfect amount of time to relax and take advantage of all of the amenities! Our favorite was the private cabanas and pool, which offered such a refreshing dip while being in the desert. The hotel also has movie nights in the patio, as well a ton of fun seating from fire pits, to boho swings, to hammocks and couches. We just loved lounging around.
The Canal Club & Bar, which is their restaurant, is partially located inside the lobby and off in its private dining space. We ate here for breakfast and for dinner. Both times were so delicious!! You can always just swing by the Canal Club for a cocktail as well.

Tap bottom left to see rates & etc 

#hotelrecommendation #thescottresort #hotelreview  #fyp #creatorsearchinsights

findings.title: local_living_unbound
findings.snippet:
If you’re planning a Scottsdale trip and want a hotel that feels stylish, social, and intentionally designed, The Scott Resort & Spa is one of the best boutique options in Scottsdale, Arizona. Located just minutes from Old Town Scottsdale, this hotel blends mid-century design with a tropical desert aesthetic, offering a more elevated alternative to larger resorts. With two palm-lined pools, a full-service spa, and the popular Canal Club restaurant, it’s ideal for couples, girls trips, and anyone prioritizing atmosphere over size. If you’re deciding where to stay in Scottsdale and want something that actually feels like a getaway, this is a top choice to consider.

findings.title: lasaidso
findings.snippet:
Needed a change of scenery for a coworking day and The Scott Resort & Spa was the perfect spot 🌿✨

The second you walk in, you hear the water features, grab a complimentary tea or infused water, and immediately feel your shoulders drop. The whole property is full of greenery, comfortable seating, and little nooks that make it easy to settle in and get some work done.

I spent a few hours there working and honestly didn’t want to leave. Between the boho-inspired design, relaxing atmosphere, and endless photo ops, it’s one of the prettiest places I’ve worked from in Scottsdale.

Bonus points for The Canal Club being right there when you need a break. Cuban-inspired food, great ambiance, and a full bar if that’s your thing.

Definitely adding this to my list of favorite places to work remotely. #fyp #thingstodoaz #scottsdalearizona #remotework #scottsdale

findings.title: valleymoms
findings.snippet:
Nestled in the heart of Old Town Scottsdale, The Scott Resort & Spa is one of those places that instantly makes you feel like you’re on vacation.

The resort is surrounded by lush landscaping, beautiful courtyards, cozy fire pits, and two stunning resort pools that create a tropical oasis in the middle of the Arizona desert. Whether you’re relaxing poolside, enjoying the spa, or simply taking in the atmosphere, every detail is designed to help you unwind.

One of my favorite amenities is the complimentary bicycles available for guests. They’re a fun and easy way to explore Old Town Scottsdale, the nearby greenbelt, local shops, art galleries, and some of the area’s best restaurants without ever needing to move your car.

The Canal Club is another highlight and easily one of the hottest spots in the Valley for a relaxing happy hour. Inspired by the flavors and culture of Havana, this stylish gathering place serves handcrafted cocktails, delicious food, and creates the perfect atmosphere for meeting friends, enjoying date night, or simply unwinding after a day of exploring Scottsdale. The indoor-outdoor setting, lively energy, and beautiful design make it a destination all on its own.

Location is another reason guests love The Scott. You’re just minutes from Scottsdale Fashion Square, Old Town Scottsdale, spring training baseball, championship golf courses, hiking trails, museums, and some of Arizona’s best dining and entertainment.

Whether you’re planning a romantic getaway, a girls’ weekend, a family vacation, or a Scottsdale staycation, The Scott Resort & Spa combines luxury, comfort, and one of the best locations in the Valley.

Book your stay and experience why this Old Town Scottsdale gem continues to be a favorite destination for visitors and locals alike.
